usage: Operating System vulnerabilities should not exist in containers
name: Vulnerable dependency (CVE) in container from Operating System
description: Containers have become an integral part of modern software development and deployment due to their ability to package applications and their dependencies into a single, portable, and efficient unit. Containers need an Operating System installed to function. Operating Systems also introduce potential security risks, including outdated, vulnerable, or misconfigured components.
detailedDescription: OS-level vulnerability scanning in containers is crucial for detecting and mitigating security risks within the base operating system layer. This process helps ensure the foundational components of a container are secure, up-to-date, and compliant, reducing the attack surface and enabling a more robust security posture for containerized applications.
